properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 28 at 5:54PM PDT until September 28 at 7:45PM PDT by NWS Las Vegas NV
properties.description:
At 554 PM MST, Light to moderate rain persists across the area and
Short Creek continues to observe flooding. Road closures are ongoing
for roads crossing Short Creek.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Colorado City.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 28 at 6:44PM MDT until September 28 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
At 644 PM MDT, Zion National Park Dispatch confirmed that flash
flooding is occurring in Heaps Canyon, as well as several other
drainages within the park. Between 0.25 and 0.75 inches of rain have
fallen, and additional light to moderate rain is expected to persist
through this evening. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Zion National Park Dispatch

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons, normally
dry washes, creeks and streams.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park and Springdale.
properties.instruction:
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 28 at 6:20PM CDT until September 28 at 10:15PM CDT by NWS Grand Forks ND
properties.description:
FFWFGF

The National Weather Service in Grand Forks has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central Clay County in northwestern Minnesota...
East Central Cass County in southeastern North Dakota...

* Until 1015 PM CDT.

* At 620 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Up to 2 inches of rain have
fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 0.5 to 1 inch in 1 hour.
Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible in the warned
area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Fargo, Moorhead, West Fargo, Dilworth, Reile's Acres, Oakport,
Frontier, Prairie Rose, Briarwood and North River.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.
